test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: The price of an article is increased by 30% and then decreased by 30%. Find the net percentage change in the final price of the article.
solution:
**Given:**

The number increased = 30%

The number decreased = 30%

Calculation:

Let the number be 100

Number after 30% increase = 100 + 30% of 100 = 130

Number after 30% decrease = 130 – 30% of 130 = 91

Overall change is number = 100 – 91 = 9

Decrease percentage = (9 / 100) × 100 = 9%

∴ The number will decrease by 9%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**We can use the successive percentage method

Total percentage change = [a + b + ab/100]%

Here a = 30 and b = – 30, a negative sign shows the percentage decrease

Percentage change = 30 – 30 – (30 × 30) / 100 = –9

∴ The number will decrease by 9%
